instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Professional Documentary aesthetic. Avoid cartoonish meme or shitpost visuals. Use sophisticated dark tones (#090B0E, #0F141C) paired with warm amber (#F59E0B) and cyan (#38BDF8) audio accents.
Implement full audio playback functionality: user can upload MP3/WAV/M4A, play/pause, seek by clicking anywhere on the timeline waveform or transcript blocks, and scrub with the red playhead.

Provide pre-loaded documentary demo projects (e.g. 'The Lost Libraries of Alexandria - 45s Narration', 'Voyage Across the Bosphorus - 30s Narration') so the user can immediately experience the timeline, waveform, and transcript segments even without uploading a file.

Show clear storage status: if Cloudflare R2 credentials (R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME) are not configured in backend .env, the backend gracefully falls back to local uploads/mock storage while the UI shows a crisp 'Local Storage Mode' status pill with setup instructions in a dialog.

Make transcription robust: include a Whisper transcription endpoint in the FastAPI backend (mock/emergent Whisper API / local fallback) that breaks speech into timestamps [ { start: 0, end: 4.2, text: '...' } ] so transcript segments correctly populate the timeline and transcript list.

Include every required data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='upload-audio-dropzone', data-testid='play-pause-button', data-testid='timeline-ruler', data-testid='timeline-playhead', data-testid='transcript-segment-0', data-testid='render-video-button', data-testid='storage-status-badge').
Ensure mobile responsiveness with horizontal scroll container and touch targets on timeline.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_purity: No purple-gradient-on-white AI slop. Stick to cinematic archive colorways and high density editorial design.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous container padding (p-6, p-8) and tight high-density timeline tracks (h-14 per lane).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: All text colors meet 4.5:1 contrast against their dark panels. Focus outlines are distinct amber rings.
